In India, a Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) generally costs
between
₹3,000 and ₹5,500 per sensor
. Since individual sensors last
10 to 15 days
, the total recurring monthly expense typically ranges from
₹6,000 to ₹11,000
, depending entirely on the brand you choose.
